evidence_requirements.claim: The finite filled right-circular cone SDF has a deterministic reference vector.
evidence_requirements.method: Evaluate the declared cone before and after one causal motion step.
evidence_requirements.pass_condition: The sealed replay contains both finite signed distances and marks the cone vector passed.

evidence_requirements.claim: The 20/18/14/12-bit SCLP key round-trips in both contiguous and Morton layouts.
evidence_requirements.method: Pack one quantized state with each layout and decode both words.
evidence_requirements.pass_condition: Both decoded states exactly equal the same original quantized state and both booleans are true.

evidence_requirements.claim: The deterministic one-bit jitter interval stays strictly inside the declared guard margin.
evidence_requirements.method: Generate the content-addressed jitter bit and record its closed interval and margin certificate.
evidence_requirements.pass_condition: The replay records distinct bit roles and jitter_safe_under_margin is true.

evidence_requirements.claim: Spatial log-polar metric, Jacobian, velocity, acceleration, and causal advance have deterministic reference values.
evidence_requirements.method: Evaluate one declared spatial chart and constant-acceleration time step.
evidence_requirements.pass_condition: The sealed metric and kinematic records exist and the proof inventory marks the vector passed.

evidence_requirements.claim: The bounded BST-T/L-system-style route stays within declared depth and active-branch budgets.
evidence_requirements.method: Record requested depth, active branches, declared maxima, resulting paths, and bounded status.
evidence_requirements.pass_condition: Used depth and branches do not exceed their maxima and bounded is true.

evidence_requirements.claim: A translational point path has a certified finite-cone SDF zero in a bounded parameter interval.
evidence_requirements.method: Maintain an opposite-sign bracket while bisecting the exact finite-cone SDF along the linear path.
evidence_requirements.pass_condition: The final interval is ordered and finite, its endpoint distances retain opposite signs, and certified is true; no earliest-impact claim is made.
